name: Shuukaku no Juunigatsu ~Aki~
source:
In the midst of an Autumn of meetings and partings, boys and girls are forced to make a decision.. This is a story that unfolds in a city where gods dwell. 

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE035708.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在充满邂逅与离别的秋季，少男少女们被迫作出抉择…这是一个发生在神明居住之城的故事。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE035708.html]DLsite English[/url]]
